hero.title: We stand behind the quality of our work
hero.description: Transparent warranty terms for vehicle repairs and maintenance.

coverage.title: Warranty on the work we perform
coverage.description: We stand behind the quality of our work and follow the repair terms agreed with the customer.

work.title: Completed work
work.description: The warranty covers work performed by our specialists in accordance with the applicable terms.

parts.title: Installed parts
parts.description: Warranty terms for installed parts depend on the manufacturer, supplier, and specific part.

quality.title: Repair quality
quality.description: We inspect the completed work before returning the vehicle to the customer.

history.title: Documented repairs
history.description: Information about completed work is stored in the vehicle's service history.

period.title: Warranty coverage period
period.description: The warranty is valid for the specified period or until the applicable mileage limit is reached.
period.note: The warranty is valid for the specified period or until the applicable mileage limit is reached, whichever comes first.

conditions.title: When the warranty applies
conditions.description: To maintain warranty coverage, the applicable service and vehicle operating conditions must be followed.

items.completedByService: The work was performed by our auto service.
items.approvedParts: Approved parts and materials were used.
items.recommendations: The service's recommendations for vehicle operation were followed.
items.serviceIntervals: The recommended maintenance intervals were followed where required by the warranty terms.
items.proofOfWork: There is confirmation of the completed work and service.

exclusions.title: What is not covered by the warranty
exclusions.description: The warranty does not cover issues unrelated to the quality of our work or caused by improper vehicle use.

items.normalWear: Normal wear and tear of parts and consumables.
items.accidentDamage: Damage caused by an accident, external impact, or mechanical damage.
items.improperUse: Failures caused by improper use of the vehicle.
items.externalRepair: Consequences of intervention or repairs performed by another service.
items.unrelatedFailure: Failures unrelated to the work performed by our service.

claim.title: Have you noticed a problem after the repair?
claim.description: Contact us — we will register your request and arrange a vehicle inspection.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Answers to the most common questions about our warranty.

scope.question: Which repairs are covered by the warranty?
scope.answer: The warranty covers work performed by our auto service in accordance with the applicable warranty terms.

period.question: How long is the warranty valid?
period.answer: The warranty period depends on the type of work performed and the applicable service terms.

parts.question: Are parts covered by the warranty?
parts.answer: Warranty terms for parts may vary depending on the manufacturer, supplier, and specific part.

problem.question: What should I do if the problem occurs again after the repair?
problem.answer: Contact us and tell us about the issue. We will arrange a vehicle inspection and determine the next steps.

externalService.question: Does the warranty remain valid after repairs at another service?
externalService.answer: Warranty terms may include restrictions if the vehicle has been repaired or modified by another service.

cta.title: Need a repair or diagnostics?
cta.description: Book a service appointment and trust your vehicle to our specialists.
